lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular blobs are arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits, forming distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal axes of high-luminance blobs, creating a semi-regular lattice of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior edge and lower intensity/shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) visible in the ventral region and trailing the pectoral fin.
